title: Classify CRVS and geospatial registries consistently as foundational DPI
requirements:
- Use one classification of foundational DPI, cross-sector authoritative systems and DPI-H throughout
- Use 'geospatial registry' terminology
- Explain the boundary between health-generated birth/death notifications and legal civil registration
- Make integration conditional on available services, with alternatives such as periodic synchronisation
- Allow interim health capability where foundational services are unavailable
